result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.motif_significance()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Test motif significance against degree-preserving random graphs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L12757-L12832){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.motif_significance( size=3, n_random=100, seed=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Computes the motif census for this graph and for `n_random=` degree-preserving rewirings, then reports a z-score and empirical p-value for each motif class. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [size]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[3]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of nodes per motif. Must be 3 or 4. [n_random]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[100]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of random graphs to generate for the null distribution. [seed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Random seed for reproducibility of the null distribution. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, return the significance results directly. Otherwise store them as a graph attribute and return `self` for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict or Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A nested dictionary `{motif_class: {count, mean_random, std_random, z_score, p_value}}`, or `self` for chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#5ff60ef1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="D") ) g.motif_significance(size=3, n_random=10, seed=23, return_dict=True) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'triangle': {'count': 1.0, 'z_score': 0.0, 'mean_random': 1.0, 'p_value': 1.0, 'std_random': 0.0}, 'path': {'p_value': 1.0, 'std_random': 0.0, 'count': 2.0, 'mean_random': 2.0, 'z_score': 0.0}} ``` ::: :::
